resources.string: Statements and artificial intelligence

To read your expenses, the text of your statement, first anonymised on your phone (IBAN, account or card numbers, name, email, phone and address removed), is sent to the nemla server and then to an artificial intelligence provider. The file itself never leaves your phone. You can withdraw this consent later in My space.
